verdict.rationale: AWS shows building blocks for background automation: script-driven CLI automation, serverless code execution via Lambda, production deployment of agents on AgentCore, and Budgets actions that automatically apply an IAM policy when a threshold is hit. The evidence never documents a general mechanism for scheduling or triggering autonomous workflows, so background autonomy is mostly implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/event-trigger mechanisms for autonomous runs, explicit evidence that AgentCore agents run unattended in the background, independent hands-on corroboration.
